For a 50-person Indian company, switching is mainly an implementation/admin problem rather than a large upfront cost. Public enterprise pricing is limited, so treat the ranges below as indicative, not quotes.

Provider	Indicative cost	Switching difficulty	Main friction
FCM Travel	Custom quote; typically transaction/program based	Medium–High	Policy setup, traveller profiles, negotiated rates, integrations
MakeMyTrip for Business	Often low/transaction-based; custom corporate pricing	Low–Medium	Migrating traveller data, approval rules and GST setup
Amex Business Travel Account + TMC	Custom pricing; account/TMC fees may apply	High	TMC transition plus centralized billing/reconciliation

FCM supports customized corporate inventory, policy controls and implementation support. 
FCM Travel
 Amex's model involves working with a TMC and centralized billing, making the migration more process-heavy. 
American Express

Practical switching budget: I’d provision roughly ₹25,000–₹1 lakh of internal/admin effort, plus any vendor implementation or integration fees explicitly quoted.

Before switching: require written confirmation on implementation fee, transaction fee, cancellation/refund handling, GST invoicing, traveller-data migration, API/expense integration, and exit/data-export terms.
